flow-definition.description:
Mints a new LOGGING_API_KEY and rolls it out to both stacks. This is a fleet-wide change and it redeploys the live stack. There is no single-stack version of it.
configs/pic-sure-logging/logging.env carries no stack segment, so one object serves every stack and only one key can exist at a time. TARGET_STACK selects which stack cuts over first, not which stack is affected.
The key is presented by the gateway and the visualization service and checked by pic-sure-logging, so all three are rendered and redeployed on each stack. Expect a short window per stack, between the Wildfly deploy and the logging deploy, where the gateway and visualization already present the new key and pic-sure-logging still checks the old one. It answers those audit events with 401 and the logging client drops them. One key covers all three services, so the two sides cannot cut over at the same instant; the window is a cost of the single-key design rather than a defect.
Both stacks must complete. Stopping after the first leaves the second stack's rendered gateway.env and visualization.env holding a key the shared object no longer carries. Its containers keep working on the old key, because they hold it in memory, until something redeploys them; then its logging container comes up on the new key while its gateway and visualization come up on the old one. That is the 401 case above, triggered later by an unrelated deploy with no obvious connection to this job.
Per-stack secrets are not touched. PICSURE_APPLICATION_TOKEN, QUERY_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN and AGGREGATE_OBFUSCATION_SALT are read back out of each stack's own rendered env files and preserved. Rotate those with Rotate PIC-SURE Stack Secrets.

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: TARGET_STACK
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: The stack that cuts over to the new key first. Based on selection we determine if is a or b stack. The other stack follows in the second stage; both are always rolled out.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: INFRASTRUCTURE_GIT_HASH
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Infrastructure repository revision to render the rotated configuration from. Leave empty to resolve it from build-spec.json.
